title: 第9章 别打扰劳资升级第10章 我云某全凭苦练何来宝物一说

不过当他们来到云阳所在的灵药园时，却发现这里并没有云阳的身影。
嗯？人呢？
为首的那位赵姓玄天门弟子扭头看向两侧，跟在其身后的两人面面相觑。
“龚师弟，怎么回事？”
右侧的那位玄天门弟子看了眼手中的卷轴，又看了眼不远处位于灵药园边缘的玉质标牌，说道：“赵师兄，是这里没错。”
“擅离职守？这位云师弟……”
话还没说完，从灵药园门口就走进来一个穿着布衣，挑着灵泉的玄天门弟子。
为首的赵师兄眉头微皱，他记得云阳是个十多岁的少年啊，怎么眼前这人却是一副络腮胡的大叔模样？
但万一是这位云师弟发育较早，胡子长的快呢？
于是赵师兄还是上前问道：“这位可是云师弟？”
“啊？我？”
挑着灵泉的玄天门弟子一愣，但看见面前这个玄天门弟子身上穿的服装纹样，竟是一等外门弟子的服饰，便连忙将挑着的灵泉放下，行礼道：“见过师兄，但师弟姓钱。”
“哦？现在看管这处药园的不是云师弟吗？怎么现在是钱师弟在看管呢？”
“哦，师兄是来找云师弟的啊，云师弟在我的药园里捉灵虫呢。”
“嗯？”赵师兄眉头微皱，他练过感知类的法术，能感知到面前这个钱师弟是炼气期三层的实力，难不成这家伙是欺压了那位云师弟？
于是便问道：“为什么云师弟会在你的药园里捉灵虫？”
“这，这可不是我强迫云师弟的，是云师弟自己想帮我的，而我过来帮云师弟的药园浇浇水。”
“什么？他主动帮你？”
赵师兄有些疑惑，他也曾看管过灵田，浇水施肥倒是容易，这灵虫却是难以防范，而且未入筑基的修士没有神识，所以很难捕捉这些隐藏在灵药之中的灵虫。

但这个云师弟竟然主动去帮别人捉灵虫？这是为何？
“他捉灵虫……很擅长？”
“可不是嘛。”挑灵泉过来的钱师弟立即说道：“这位云师弟就好像开了神识似的，不管灵虫藏的多深，他总能一下子就抓住。”
难不成这位云师弟在精神力方面有特长？
“还请这位钱师弟带我们前往你的药园，我们找云师弟有事相商。”
“好的好的，还请三位师兄跟我来。”
三人一路走到这位姓钱的玄天门外门弟子所看守的丙字202号药园，走到药园门口时，赵师兄突然伸手拦住身后三人。
“怎么了赵师兄？”
“别急，先看看。”
三人趴在药园边上，明明是修仙人，这一刻却像是几个八卦偷听似的小贼。
但之后，他们就看见，云阳在行走在灵田之间，时不时的从灵田里揪出来一只灵虫，然后直接往嘴里塞去。
“噗嗤~”
嫩绿的汁水在云阳齿间炸开，云阳“bia唧bia唧”两口将灵虫吞下。
“呕！”
偷窥的玄天门弟子一个没忍住，差点呕吐出来。
他们虽已踏上修仙路，但还未进筑基，也不能辟谷，对于这种味觉的生理反应还是存在的。
就算是为首的那位赵师兄，面色也有些难看。
原本以为你是被修为高的外门弟子霸凌了，结果你竟然是主动帮别人。
可当我以为你是乐于助人的时候，结果你特么是因为嘴馋？
还特么的是馋虫子？

你可真是个小馋猫。
“这……”那位龚师弟有些犹豫，“赵师兄，你说，我们还招揽他吗？”
“……”
赵师兄强行压下肚腹的反胃感，镇定的说道：“龚师弟，这就是你不懂了，你要知道，这些天才们，多多少少都会有些怪癖，这也是很正常的事。”
这时，那位一直没开口的玄天门弟子突然说道：“那慕容师兄是不是也有……”

But when they came to the elixir garden where Yunyang was, they found that Yunyang was not there.
Um? Where are people?
The leading Xuantianmen disciple surnamed Zhao turned his head and looked to both sides, and the two people following him looked at each other in confusion.
"Junior brother Gong, what's going on?"
The Xuantian Sect disciple on the right looked at the scroll in his hand, then at the jade sign not far away at the edge of the Spiritual Medicine Garden, and said, "Senior Brother Zhao, this is the right place."
"Abandoned his duties without permission? This Junior Brother Yun..."
Before he finished speaking, a disciple of the Xuantian Clan wearing civilian clothes and carrying a spiritual spring walked in from the entrance of the Spiritual Medicine Garden.
The leader, Senior Brother Zhao, frowned slightly. He remembered that Yunyang was a teenager, but why did the man in front of him look like a bearded uncle?
But what if Junior Brother Yun develops earlier and his beard grows faster?
So Senior Brother Zhao stepped forward and asked, "Is this Junior Brother Yun?"
"Huh? Me?"
The Xuantian Clan disciple who was carrying the Lingquan was stunned for a moment, but when he saw that the pattern of clothing worn by the Xuantian Clan disciple in front of him was that of a first-class outer disciple, he quickly put down the Lingquan he was carrying and saluted, "I have met my senior brother, but his surname is Qian."
"Oh? Isn't it Junior Brother Yun who is looking after this medicine garden now? Why is it that Junior Brother Qian is looking after it now?"
"Oh, senior brother is here to see junior brother Yun. Junior brother Yun is catching spiritual insects in my medicine garden."
"Huh?" Senior Brother Zhao frowned slightly. He had practiced perception spells and could sense that Junior Brother Qian in front of him was at the third level of the Qi Refining Stage. Could it be that this guy bullied Junior Brother Yun?
So he asked: "Why would Junior Brother Yun catch spiritual insects in your medicine garden?"
"This, I didn't force Junior Brother Yun to do this. It was Junior Brother Yun who wanted to help me, and I came over to help water Junior Brother Yun's medicine garden."
"What? He offered to help you?"
Senior Brother Zhao was a little confused. He had also taken care of the spiritual field. It was easy to water and fertilize, but it was difficult to prevent these spiritual insects. Moreover, monks who had not entered the foundation building had no spiritual consciousness, so it was difficult to catch these spiritual insects hidden in the elixir.
But this Junior Brother Yun actually took the initiative to help others catch spiritual insects? Why is this?
"He's very good at catching spiritual insects?"
"Isn't that right?" Junior Brother Qian who came over to pick up the spirit spring said immediately: "Junior Brother Yun seems to have opened up his spiritual consciousness. No matter how deep the spirit insect is hidden, he can always catch it at once."
Is it possible that Junior Brother Yun has special abilities in mental power?
"Please also ask this Junior Brother Qian to take us to your medicine garden. We can discuss anything with Junior Brother Yun."
"Okay, okay, please three senior brothers to come with me."
The three of them walked all the way to No. 202 Medicine Garden, C, which was guarded by the outer disciple of the Xuantian Sect named Qian. When they reached the entrance of the medicine garden, Senior Brother Zhao suddenly stretched out his hand to stop the three people behind him.
"What's wrong, Senior Brother Zhao?"
"Don't worry, let's take a look first."
The three of them were lying on the edge of the medicine garden. They were obviously cultivators, but at this moment they looked like a few thieves eavesdropping on gossip.
But then, they saw Yunyang walking among the spiritual fields, pulling out a spiritual insect from the spiritual fields from time to time, and then stuffing it directly into his mouth.
"Pfft~"
The green juice exploded between Yunyang's teeth, and Yunyang swallowed the spirit worm in two mouthfuls.
"Ugh!"
None of the peeping Xuantianmen disciples could hold back and almost vomited.
Although they have embarked on the path of cultivating immortals, they have not yet entered the foundation building, and they cannot live without food, so they still have physiological reactions to this kind of taste.
Even the leader, Senior Brother Zhao, looked a little ugly.
I originally thought you were being bullied by a high-level outer disciple, but you actually took the initiative to help others.
But when I thought you were helpful, it turned out that you were greedy?
What the hell is a glutton?
You are such a greedy little cat.
"This..." Junior Brother Gong hesitated, "Senior Brother Zhao, do you think we should still recruit him?""..."
Senior Brother Zhao suppressed the nausea in his stomach and said calmly: "Junior Brother Gong, you don't understand. You have to know that these geniuses will have some quirks, which is normal."
At this time, the Xuantian Clan disciple who had been silent until now suddenly said, "Does Senior Brother Murong also have..."
